description: Maai- en reinigingsbestek wegen en vaarwegen is a series of datasets listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. In dit bestand staan de vlakobjecten langs provinciale wegen en vaarwegen die gemaaid moeten worden. Iedere 3 jaar (eventueel met een verlenging) worden objecten langs provinciale wegen die gemaaid of gereinigd moeten worden opgenomen in een bestek van de eenheid Wegen en Kanalen en vervolgens uitgevoerd door een aannemer die het bestek heeft aangenomen. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are bermbeplanting, bermen, wegen. It offers 8 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JPEG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC, HTTPS://DATA.OVERHEID.NL/FORMAT/UNKNOWN. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
